portal_hypertension.title: Albumin-to-creatinine ratio as non-invasive marker for prediction of non- bleeding esophageal varices. a cross-sectional observational study.
portal_hypertension.authors: Mousa N, Elmetwalli A, Abdelsalam M
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 260）。核心观点：非侵入性生物标志物可以帮助识别应立即接受内窥镜评估的高危患者。 临床提示：虽然上消化道内窥镜检查是检测 EV 的首选方法，但它可能并非在所有情况下都可行。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Esophageal varices (EV) are a frequent complication of liver cirrhosis and a leading cause of gastrointestinal bleeding and mortality. While upper gastrointestinal endoscopy is the preferred method for detecting EV, it may not be feasible in all settings. Non-invasive biomarkers could assist in identifying high-risk patients who should undergo prompt endoscopic evaluation. This study assessed the accuracy of the albumin-to-creatinine ratio (ACR) as a non-invasive predictor of EV in individuals with liver cirrhosis. portal_hypertension.title: Early-onset extrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma in a young adult with a resected congenital biliary cyst: a rare case report.
portal_hypertension.authors: Hraib M, Alkasem B, Mahasny L
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于病例研究。核心观点：先天性胆总管囊肿是公认的后续肝胆恶性肿瘤（尤其是胆管癌）的危险因素，即使在手术切除后也是如此。 临床提示：然而，新生儿先天性胆管囊肿切除后在成年早期发生肝外胆管癌（eCCA）的情况极为罕见。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Congenital choledochal cysts are well-recognized risk factors for subsequent hepatobiliary malignancy, particularly cholangiocarcinoma, even after surgical excision. However, the development of extrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma (eCCA) in early adulthood following neonatal resection of a congenital biliary cyst is exceptionally rare. We report a case of early-onset eCCA in a young woman who was previously treated surgically in the neonatal period.
